annotation.title_clean: 网络安全技术 生成式人工智能服务安全基本要求
annotation.title_en: Cybersecurity technology—Basic security requirements for generative artificial intelligence service
annotation.authors_or_issuer: TC260 (National Technical Committee 260 on Cybersecurity of SAC); China Electronics Standardization Institute et al.
annotation.venue: National Public Service Platform for Standards Information (GB/T 45654-2025)
annotation.summary_en: Catalogue metadata page for Chinese national standard GB/T 45654-2025, setting basic security requirements for generative AI services. Issued 25 April 2025, effective 1 November 2025, drafted under TC260 with many companies and universities. Only metadata and related standards are shown, not the requirements text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Administered by TC260 under the Standardization Administration of China
Drafted by CESI, Baidu, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei, DeepSeek and universities
Lists related generative AI security standards, e.g. GB/T 45652-2025 and GB/T 45674-2025
